map.心率变异性分析是做什么的？: What does Heart Rate Variability (HRV) Analyzer do?
map.如何使用心率变异性分析？: How do I use Heart Rate Variability (HRV) Analyzer?
map.心率变异性分析适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Heart Rate Variability (HRV) Analyzer best for?
map.输入 R-R 间期序列（单位毫秒，用空格/逗号/换行分隔），计算 SDNN、RM: Enter an R-R interval series (milliseconds, space/comma/newline separated) to compute time-domain HRV metrics such as SDNN, RMSSD and pNN50 for autonomic-nervous-system assessment.
map.心率变异性 HRV：由 R-R 间期序列算 平均 NN、SDNN（总体标准差）、: Heart rate variability (HRV): from an R-R interval series, compute the mean NN, SDNN (overall standard deviation), RMSSD (root mean square of successive differences) and pNN50 (share of successive differences > 50 ms), reflecting autonomic tone.
map.💡 SDNN=全部NN间期标准差；RMSSD=相邻NN差值的均方根；pNN50=: 💡 SDNN = standard deviation of all NN intervals; RMSSD = root mean square of successive NN differences; pNN50 = share of successive NN differences > 50 ms; a higher RMSSD means stronger parasympathetic (vagal) tone and better recovery
map.建议使用短时记录（5 分钟静息）的 R-R 间期，至少 10 个以上数据点效果更: Use a short-term recording (5-minute rest) of R-R intervals; at least 10 data points give better results
map.R-R 间期单位为毫秒(ms)，若你的设备导出为秒，请乘以 1000 后输入: R-R intervals are in milliseconds (ms); if your device exports seconds, multiply by 1000 before entering
map.异常搏动（早搏）会显著干扰结果，建议先剔除明显异常值: Abnormal beats (premature beats) significantly distort the result, so remove obvious outliers first
map.HRV 受年龄、呼吸、压力、咖啡因影响大，需在固定条件下测量比较: HRV is strongly affected by age, breathing, stress and caffeine, so measure under consistent conditions to compare
map.HRV 反映恢复与自主神经平衡。: HRV reflects recovery and autonomic balance.
map.晨起 HRV 趋势判断训练负荷耐受，HRV 持续走低提示需主动减量恢复。: Use the morning HRV trend to judge training-load tolerance; a persistently falling HRV signals a need to back off and recover.
map.常用 RMSSD（相邻 R-R 间期差均方根），静息越高通常恢复越好。: RMSSD (root mean square of successive R-R differences) is commonly used; a higher resting value usually means better recovery.
map.HRV 低说明？: What does a low HRV mean?
map.可能疲劳/压力，宜降负荷。: Possible fatigue or stress; reduce the load.
map.HRV 一天内波动大正常吗？: Is large within-day HRV fluctuation normal?
map.受睡眠、压力、酒精影响大，应固定时间（晨起静卧）测才具有可比性。: It is strongly affected by sleep, stress and alcohol, so measure at a fixed time (on waking, lying still) for comparability.
map.心率变异性（HRV）分析工具，输入 R-R 间期序列，计算平均 NN 间期、平均: A heart rate variability (HRV) analysis tool: enter an R-R interval series to compute time-domain metrics including the mean NN interval, mean heart rate, SDNN, RMSSD, pNN50, NN50, SDSD and the coefficient of variation CVRR, and assess autonomic (parasympathetic) recovery state from RMSSD, helping athletes monitor fatigue and recovery.
map.一次计算 8 项 HRV 时域指标: Computes 8 time-domain HRV metrics at once
map.支持空格、逗号、换行多种分隔: Supports space, comma and newline separators
map.自动换算平均心率与变异系数: Automatically computes mean heart rate and coefficient of variation
map.晨起静息 HRV 监测训练恢复: Monitoring training recovery with morning resting HRV
map.科研教学 HRV 指标演示: Demonstrating HRV metrics for research and teaching
